full_page.content:
1946, April 5
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Sclanus Casey, O.J.K. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH CAPUCHIN MONASTERY 225 Jerome Street Brooklyn 7, F. Y.
April 5th 1946.
Dr. William Koch. Dast Jefferson Avenue Detroit, Michigan. My Dear Doctor Koch:
God bless you and yours.
I do hope that you are well; and that by this time you are able, as once before, to smile at the seemingly desperate efforts of your really pittyable, international enemies. Pittyabl, because so frequent- ly perverters of justice and truth. No doubt you have been wondering at my silence and seemingly want of appreciation/ your generous favor of several weeks ago. I feel that, were my failure to acknowled same to continue much longer someone might even be scandalized. Not that I have failed to remember your kindness and charity or that I have not made efforts to write you; but I wanted to get something to you that would be really worth while, and that takes time.
Besides all this dear Doctor; there has been something else in my mind I wanted to get it into yours: viz, to get you to realize that there is very likely something
(Unfinished Draft)
